rhoMatrix: Correlation Matrices from Covariance Matrices

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Source: vignettes/rhoMatrix.Rmd
rhoMatrix.Rmd

Description

Correlation matrices from covariance matrices in R (R Core Team, 2026). Each exported function has an internal version without input checks that other projects can copy.

Installation

You can install the development version of rhoMatrix from GitHub with:

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/rhoMatrix")

Example 

library(package = "rhoMatrix")
sigmacap <- stats::cov(x = datasets::mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt", "hp")])
RhoofSigma(x = sigmacap)
#>            mpg         wt         hp
#> mpg  1.0000000 -0.8676594 -0.7761684
#> wt  -0.8676594  1.0000000  0.6587479
#> hp  -0.7761684  0.6587479  1.0000000
